svg.text: NVDA: 21-day forecast vs realized variance, out-of-sample
Walk-forward, expanding window, 21-day embargo · 2020-08-10 to 2026-06-15 · 1469 scored days · log scale
No model beats EWMA significantly. GARCH scores best by sitting high and flat (5.8× range against realized's 20.8×), never badly caught low; GBT runs low and loses to GARCH on QLIKE.
